run_record.developer_review: Scores (2, 2, 2) and the three follow-up questions are usable, and the run completed with no key or cost. Weak points: the sentences the AI chose as support are often poor matches (for workflow it chose the title line), and all 3 flags are incorrect (the saved table does not mention density matrix simulation, and the quantum model had lower, not higher, accuracy). Next changes to test: a larger free model on a Colab GPU, and a rule-based number check to replace AI flags.
